default_run: plays once and holds recovery unless --loop is passed

phase_metrics.phase: Quality proxy degradation or explicit no-quality-impact period

phases: Quality proxy degradation or explicit no-quality-impact period

visible_behavior.Cycle drift or bottleneck: cycle time distribution shifts and station-3 ranks highest
visible_behavior.Incident candidate: top inspection table names station-3 and physical-machine reason
visible_behavior.Normal running: line overview normal, cycle near target
visible_behavior.Physical machine drift: vibration, current, and thermal scores rise
visible_behavior.Planned changeover or state transition: production state changes without incident when same-state comparison is used
visible_behavior.Recovery or incomplete recovery: process, cycle, and source scores fall or incomplete recovery remains visible
visible_behavior.Sensor/tag degradation: vibration sensor freshness and disagreement rise
